SELECT l.id, l.app_id AS appId, a.app_name AS appName, l.username, l.ip_address AS ipAddress, l.location, l.browser, l.os, l.login_type AS loginType, l.status, l.message, l.login_at AS loginAt FROM sys_login_log l LEFT JOIN sys_app a ON a.app_id = l.app_id AND a.deleted = 0
ORDER BY l.login_at DESC LIMIT #{limit} OFFSET #{offset}

SELECT l.app_id AS appId, a.app_name AS appName, l.username, l.ip_address, l.location, l.browser, l.os, l.status, l.message, l.login_at FROM sys_login_log l LEFT JOIN sys_app a ON a.app_id = l.app_id AND a.deleted = 0
ORDER BY l.login_at DESC LIMIT 10000
